mapper.sql: select c.commission_id, c.distributor_id, c.order_id, o.order_no, c.store_id, s.store_name, m.nickname as member_name, c.amount, c.rate, c.status, c.settle_time, c.settled_to_distributor, c.create_time, c.merchant_id from biz_commission c left join biz_store s on s.store_id = c.store_id left join biz_order o on o.order_id = c.order_id left join biz_distributor d on d.distributor_id = c.distributor_id left join biz_member m on m.member_id = d.member_id
